body:
Quick pass, not an independent review, for `b19feb4cf16da64cb1862dd4d438385576205114`.

The PR targets `NeoTech/Camcraft:main` from `seelesturm/Camcraft-NeoTech:issue/3815-external-agent-guide`. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. The published diff equals the local three-file diff. The PR body names the sources, focused checks and untested behavior.

The focused JSON, tool-schema and link checks pass. `git diff --check` passes. The quick dry-run selects zero Rust steps; it is not a test pass. The review-time light lane is not run for this scoped prose change. No CI checks are reported. The two-app runtime is not exercised.

The PR is ready for independent review. No merge or auto-merge is requested.

Effort: low. No escalation.

Independent contributor pre-check for `b19feb4cf16da64cb1862dd4d438385576205114`. This is not a collaborator approval.

No blocking finding was found in the three-file documentation change.

Checks performed on this head:
- The published diff equals the inspected local diff. `git diff --check` passes.
- A new read-only MCP initialization and tool listing returns 124 tool names. They match the current source registry.
- All 21 JSON table calls parse. The 16 CamCraft table calls and six additional inline calls pass the applicable schema checks.
- All nine relative guide links and the README link resolve. The client configuration parses as JSON.
- The pinned public SolidCraft MCP documentation and modeling reference were fetched again. Their bridge and command contracts support the examples.
- Source inspection confirms the native cache restrictions, model-link behavior, window-only watcher, separate histories and live approval restrictions.
- The quick dry-run selects zero steps. This is not a Rust test pass. No CI checks are reported.

The complete two-app runtime, GUI, SolidCraft runtime, Rust suites, Clippy and light lane were not run. No posting or machine execution was performed. The guide and PR state these limits. This pre-check does not replace the maintainer's review or establish physical machine safety.

Effort: low. No escalation.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b19feb4cf16da64cb1862dd4d438385576205114 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

Reviewed the complete three-file diff against upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`.
This is a documentation change. It changes no G-code, geometry, collision checks, stock simulation, UI, dependencies or process files.

What looks good:
- The guide meets #3815. It gives two explicit stdio bridges, a local part example, model links, and separate undo histories.
- The guide states the manual approval and cloud privacy limits. It does not claim that the complete two-app session was tested.
- The native cache restrictions, STEP fallback, window watcher and live approval descriptions agree with the current source.
- The decision file records the scope and alternatives. The body and commit contain the required issue reference.

Local results:
- PR head: `b19feb4cf16da64cb1862dd4d438385576205114`.
- Main: `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
- Trial merge: `eaf3acf4d7e173d57ba64a26779ed33556114e1d`. Its first parent is the PR head. Main is already an ancestor of that head.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: pass.
- Client configuration: valid JSON. All 21 table argument objects parse.
- All 16 CamCraft table calls match the source tool names and applicable argument contracts. The inline link and pocket examples also agree with their schemas.
- All nine relative guide links and the README destination resolve.
- The two pinned public SolidCraft references support the bridge, save, export, box and hole examples.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: completed, zero selected steps. This is not a Rust test result.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: six steps passed, zero failed, zero stalled. The release build passed. All 11 selected tests passed.

Extra suites run:
| Suite | Passed | Failed |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| motion light: lib | 7 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_island | 1 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_neck | 1 | 0 |
| motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel | 1 | 0 |
| app light: pocket_pass_start | 1 | 0 |

The initial Cargo invocation stopped making progress through sccache. I interrupted it and repeated the command with the wrapper disabled. Both gate commands then completed locally. No GitHub runner was used.

Mutations: not applicable to this documentation diff. No goldens moved. The fixture, importer and example catalog rules select no extra suites.
Clippy and UI suites were not run because no Rust or UI code changed. Full heavy lanes were not run.
The complete SolidCraft/CamCraft runtime walkthrough, GUI, posting and machine execution were not exercised.

Requested before merge: none.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No PR code or evidence was committed or pushed.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
